## WHO IS DR. KEN Z. CAI?

Dr. Ken Z. Cai, Ph.D. — **Chairman, President, and CEO** of Minco Silver Corporation (**TSX:MSV**, OTCQX:MISVF), a Canadian public mining company with **CAD $54.1 million in cash** and a market cap of **CAD $38.2 million**.

From **2060-1055 West Georgia Street, Vancouver**, Dr. Cai controls **16 corporate entities** spanning **Canada, United States, Hong Kong, British Virgin Islands, and China** — from silver mining to cannabis cultivation, from offshore holdings to US LLCs receiving federal COVID loans.

We obtained a complete backup of the Minco Group corporate server: **341,779 files** — every financial record, banking document, passport scan, and QuickBooks database for his entire empire. Coverage: **2002 through August 2026**.

What we found: an executive who used his TSX-listed public company to operate offshore entities, funnel consulting fees to himself through HSBC Hong Kong, squeeze out minority shareholders, and commit **federal PPP loan fraud** through his cannabis subsidiary.

## SBA PPP LOAN FRAUD

![PPP Fraud](screenshots/03_ppp_fraud.png)

### SBA Loan #2477698408

**HempNova Lifetech USA Corp** (EIN: 364964453) — **100% owned by HempNova Lifetech Corp of Vancouver** — controlled by **Ken Cai through Minco** — received **$163,097 in PPP loan** on February 5, 2021, and obtained **100% forgiveness**.

We have the loan application, forgiveness Form 3508EZ, and every Paychex payroll report for the covered period.

![Terminal: Payroll Audit](screenshots/10_term_ppp_payroll.png)

### Employee Count Fraud

The application stated **8 employees**. Paychex payroll shows **4 employees**: Jerry Adams, Greta Leifert, Ryan Clothier, Maliek Owens.

| Reported | Actual (Paychex) | Overstatement |
|---|---|---|
| **8 employees** (application) | **4 employees** | **100%** |
| 7 employees (forgiveness) | 5 employees | 40% |

During the 24-week period, 8 individuals cycled through payroll — never more than 6 at once. One employee worked from a **California address** on an Oregon hemp farm.

### Rent & Utility Overstatement

| Category | Claimed | Actual | Overstated |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Rent** | **$145,543** | **~$131,747** | **~$14,000** |
| **Utilities** | **$34,581** | **~$15,000-20,000** | **~$15,000+** |

### The Minco Connection

Parent on SBA application: **HEMPNOVA LIFETECH CORP**, address **2060-1055 West Georgia St, Vancouver BC** (= Minco Silver HQ), email **MHSU@MINCOMINING.CA**, phone **604-688-8002** (= Minco Silver).

**18 U.S.C. § 1014**: up to **30 years** imprisonment. **18 U.S.C. § 1001**: up to **5 years**. No statute of limitations for PPP fraud over $100K.
